title: Gone in 60 Seconds
tagline: Fifty cars. One night. Eleanor goes last.
about: A retired car thief has one night to steal 50 cars for a gangster, or his little brother goes in the car crusher.

    StartersCar-crusher smash burger slidersCalitri's car crusher, waiting for Kip. Smashed beef, American cheese, pickles, onion.How to make it500g beef mince, 20 per cent fat8 soft slider buns8 slices of American cheese1 white onion, very thinly sliced8 dill pickle slices3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp American mustard20g butterMix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard for the sauce.Roll the mince into 8 loose balls and season well with salt.Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the balls, lay onion on each and smash flat with a spatula as hard as you can.Cook until the edges are dark and lacy, flip, add the cheese and cook a minute more.Butter and toast the buns, then build with sauce, pickles and a patty.Otto's dog, chilli and cheeseOtto's dog swallows the keys. Beef frank, slow chilli, melted cheddar, onion.How to make it250g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tin crushed tomatoes8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls100g cheddar, grated1/2 white onion, finely diced, to serveBrown the mince, breaking it up, then add the onion and garlic and cook until soft.Stir in the chilli powder and cumin, add the tomatoes and a splash of water, and simmer until thick.Grill the franks, turning, until blistered.Tuck them into the toasted rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar and raw onion.Long Beach dock street tacosEvery car goes to Atley at the docks. Chipotle fish, lime slaw, crema, corn tortillas.How to make it500g firm white fish fillets, such as flathead1 tbsp chipotle in adobo, chopped1 tsp ground cumin2 limes2 cups red cabbage, finely shredded1/2 cup coriander leaves125g sour cream12 small corn tortillas1 tbsp olive oilRub the fish with the chipotle, cumin, oil and salt.Toss the cabbage with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt; mix the sour cream with a squeeze of lime.Sear the fish in a hot pan until it flakes, about 3 minutes a side, then break into chunks.Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, then fill with fish, slaw, crema and coriander, with lime wedges.Salted peanuts in the shellOn the bar, where Sway works nights.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Off the GrillHeist night barbecue ribs with buttermilk slawSway feeds Toby at the barbecue. Sticky pork ribs, smoky rub, crunchy slaw.How to make it2kg pork spare ribs, in racks2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp smoked paprika2 tsp garlic powder1 tsp cayenne pepper250ml smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp apple cider vinegar1/4 green cabbage, finely shredded2 carrots, grated125ml buttermilk3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseMix the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and 2 teaspoons of salt and rub all over the ribs.Wrap the racks tightly in foil and bake at 150°C until the meat pulls back from the bones.Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise and a tablespoon of the vinegar, and toss with the cabbage and carrot.Mix the barbecue sauce with the rest of the vinegar, brush over the ribs and char on a hot barbecue or under the grill, basting, until sticky.Cut between the bones and serve with the slaw.SweetSixty-second chocolate mug cakes with salted caramelSaved for last, like Eleanor. Molten middle, caramel, vanilla ice cream.How to make it8 tbsp self-raising flour8 tbsp caster sugar4 tbsp cocoa powder2 eggs8 tbsp milk6 tbsp vegetable oil8 squares of dark chocolate4 tbsp salted caramel sauce4 scoops of vanilla ice creamWhisk the flour, sugar and cocoa in a bowl, then beat in the eggs, milk and oil until smooth.Divide between 4 large microwave-safe mugs and push 2 squares of chocolate into the middle of each.Microwave each mug on high for about 60 seconds, until risen but still soft in the centre.Top each with a spoon of salted caramel and a scoop of ice cream and serve straight away.Sway's BarSway's michelada with Tecate and limeSway fixes cars by day, pours drinks by night. Lager, lime, hot sauce, salted rim.How to make it4 x 355ml cans of Tecate or other Mexican lager250ml tomato juice3 limes2 tsp hot sauce1 tsp soy sauce2 tbsp chilli salt1 cup iceRun a lime wedge round the rim of 4 glasses and dip in the chilli salt.Mix the tomato juice, the juice of 2 limes, the hot sauce and soy sauce.Fill the glasses with ice, add the tomato mix and top slowly with the cold beer.Ice-cold Corona with a wedge of limeFor the barbecue, once all 50 are in.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
